The store has been renovated and looks nice, but the store manager has a bad attitude. All the other staff members are very helpful. It's a very unpleasant experience.

I love this place. It’s super fun for foreigners. Japanese people have some “weird” pets like chinchillas, monkeys, birds, lizards and sea creatures. It’s a fun 15min stop if you happen to be staying at an Airbnb close by.

I left my dog ​​at ZOO Yotsuya for the first time when I went on a long trip abroad. In addition to taking care of his basic needs such as changing his litter box, I was able to receive comprehensive services such as daily walks and subsequent bottom wiping as an option. I was relieved to find that my dog ​​was in very good health when I brought him back. I highly recommend this pet hotel as it is a very satisfying and reliable choice.
It's a must-see for small animal lovers
She's not for sale, but the shop's mascot dog, Grace, is adorable. Even when the door is open, she doesn't come out even though she's allowed to roam freely.
They have the cutest pets here and all the things pet related. Was allowed to geek out over the furry pets they had.

It's always open, which is very helpful.

However, the food is a bit pricey.
That's the worst.
I'm completely smitten with the budgie I got from this store. Thank you so much. It's growing up healthy and adorable.

I’m deeply concerned about the conditions I witnessed in this shop.
The animals appeared stressed and poorly cared for, and the environment did not seem suitable or humane. It’s heartbreaking to see living beings treated this way.
Please reconsider supporting businesses that keep animals in such conditions. Animals deserve proper care, not to be used for profit at the expense of their wellbeing and health just to entertain arrogant people for some “exotic experience “.
Don’t support them!
I'm sorry to say this, but the stock is low and the prices are higher than other pet shops.
When I entered the store, I was greeted by big dogs. They were so cute. There were many different animals on the second floor.

Since it's a pet shop, there probably aren't many people who dislike animals, but I was surprised to be greeted by a large dog as soon as I entered the store.

On the second floor, there were fish and unusual creatures. There weren't that many different kinds, though.

It's exciting to see so many unfamiliar exotic animals and reptiles, but the meerkats, who need some sunshine, are kept in containers with no sunlight at all, and are probably stressed out by being near talkative parrots.

The music is loud, the air conditioning is on high, and it's hard to believe that this is a pet-first environment.

The focus is on selling the kittens and puppies, so I imagine their food is minimal.
Their staff is super kind. All animals are well taken care of. Even their resident pets
I went to buy crickets for feeding my pets. It seemed like they didn't have many in stock!
I raised a hedgehog and a hamster, and they grew up really well!
The shop has two floors, and the second floor had a variety of small animal-related products. It also appears to offer a pet hotel service.
There are kookaburras

Five stars for this adorable cockatiel! He was bored and dozing off, but after I played Totoro for him, he became very interested, listened attentively, and even sang along—so cute! I hope he finds a good home and lives a healthy and happy life into his thirties 💗
While I was looking around, a shop assistant came up to ask what I was looking for. Unfortunately, my Japanese is too poor, and when I explained that I was a foreigner, the assistant panicked, which made me feel quite embarrassed 😆
I bought some snacks and tableware at the store as souvenirs for my son—the prices were all very reasonable.

I always use your nail trimming service.
It's so fast, I really appreciate it! ✨
The dogs walking around the shop are so cute!
Thank you!
The first floor sells dogs and cats, and the second floor sells exotic animals. The parakeets were so cute. They were eager to be petted.
I asked for mealworms at the register and they brought them to me.

I came in today just for a nail trim, but they were able to accommodate me immediately despite my sudden visit!

Also, I wanted my nails trimmed a little more, but they explained everything carefully and thoroughly, which made me feel very at ease!

All the staff were so kind, it was great!

Thank you very much!

I have entered this shop 4 times in search of a pet and not one time have the staff greeted me. They don’t care. Spending 400,000 yen I do expect high service. I don’t think their customer service is good or they just don’t greet foreigners. Let’s hope they are not racist and just have poor service.
The female staff had a bad attitude.
